Record a fitted feature engineering step so it is applied at prediction

Source: R/FeatureEngineering.R
recordFeatureEngineeringStep.Rd

Call this at the end of a feature engineering 'implement' function, before returning trainData. When the model is applied to new data, PatientLevelPrediction calls the recorded steps again, in the order they were recorded.

Usage

recordFeatureEngineeringStep(trainData, funct, settings)

Arguments

trainData

The data the implement function received and changed.

funct

The name of the implement function to call at prediction.

settings

A named list of the other arguments for that call.

Value

trainData, with the step added to attr(trainData$covariateData, "metaData")$featureEngineering.

Details

At prediction the function named funct is called with trainData (a copy of the data to transform) and the elements of settings as arguments. Put everything the function needs to repeat the step in settings, such as the featureEngineeringSettings and the values learned from the training data. The model is saved as JSON, so settings should hold only numbers, strings, logicals, data frames and lists of these.

Examples

covariateData <- Andromeda::andromeda(
  covariates = data.frame(rowId = 1:3, covariateId = 1, covariateValue = c(1, 5, 9))
)
trainData <- list(covariateData = covariateData)
trainData <- recordFeatureEngineeringStep(
  trainData,
  funct = "capCovariateValues",
  settings = list(featureEngineeringSettings = list(), cap = 5)
)
attr(trainData$covariateData, "metaData")$featureEngineering
#> [[1]]
#> [[1]]$funct
#> [1] "capCovariateValues"
#> 
#> [[1]]$settings
#> [[1]]$settings$featureEngineeringSettings
#> list()
#> 
#> [[1]]$settings$cap
#> [1] 5
#> 
#> 
#> 
Andromeda::close(covariateData)
